_readme: Rough monthly living cost for one person including rent, in USD, used ONLY to rank pay against local cost of living in /rank (never as a filter, never shown as fact). Planning-grade estimates compiled 2026-10-30 from general knowledge of public cost-of-living indices; they are not authoritative and drift every year. Replace any value with your own research (e.g. a Numbeo or Expatistan city page) and keep the country codes. Remote jobs are ranked against the Indonesia value because you would live there.
